chunks: Whoever remembers Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, in the marketplaces, Allah will forgive him according to the number of those in them, among the eloquent and the non-Arabic-speaking.

key_terms.أَعْجَمَ: one who is non-Arabic-speaking or inarticulate
key_terms.الْأَسْوَاقِ: the marketplaces or places of trade
key_terms.فَصِيحٍ: one who speaks eloquently or clearly

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for remembering Allah in the marketplace?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages dhikr in places of worldly distraction such as marketplaces. It teaches that remembering Allah there is a cause of immense forgiveness proportional to the number of people present.
